newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SHIPYARD SHARES DUE FOR BOURSE MAY 5.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SHIPYARD SHARES DUE FOR BOURSE MAY 5.

text.p: The stock exchange said on Friday it will start quoting the shares of Riga Shipyard on May 5 but a decision on which list it will join has yet to be made.
Stock exchange finance department director Guntar Kokarevichs told Reuters that the bourse would decide which list it would join on May 2.
The decision depended on whether Riga Shipyard submitted all its financial data on time and that they were of a high quality.
"If the current information about the company is confirmed, I do not see any problems," he said.
An 8.37 percent stake in Riga Shipyard was sold for 1.39 lats a share earlier this week.
